Officer's narrative
Driver 1 was traveling northbound through the signalized intersection in League City, Texas, when the vehicle was
struck on the driver's side by Driver 2, who was proceeding westbound and entered the intersection as the signal
changed. The point of impact and the resulting intrusion into the driver's door are consistent with a side collision at the
speed reported by both drivers. Driver 1 was the operator of the vehicle, and a Passenger was seated in the front
right position. Officers on scene confirmed Driver 1's presence in the vehicle at the time of impact, and this was also
confirmed by two independent witnesses who observed the collision from the adjacent corner. Photographs taken at
the scene show damage to the driver's side panels and door that corresponds with the force of the impact described
by all parties. Driver 2 acknowledged entering the intersection and did not dispute the sequence of events. No prior
damage to the vehicle was noted in the records reviewed or reported by either party. Driver 1 reported pain in the
lower back shortly after the collision and was transported for evaluation. The reported symptoms are consistent with
the mechanism of injury observed at the scene.
